mapper.select: UPDATE interview_plan_drafts SET status = 'PROCESSING', attempt_count = COALESCE(attempt_count, 0) + 1, generation_deadline_at = #{deadline}, updated_by = requested_by, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{draftId} AND generation_message_id = #{messageId} AND COALESCE(attempt_count, 0) < #{maxAttempts} AND ( status = 'PENDING' OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND (generation_deadline_at IS NULL OR generation_deadline_at <= #{now}) ) ) RETURNING id AS draft_id, generation_message_id AS message_id, enterprise_id, application_id, template_id, request_json::TEXT AS request_json, input_snapshot_json::TEXT AS input_snapshot_json, attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_plan_drafts SET status = 'READY', plan_json = #{planJson}::jsonb, llm_config_snapshot = #{snapshotJson}::jsonb, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, generation_deadline_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL, updated_by = requested_by, trace_id = #{traceId}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{draftId} AND generation_message_id = #{messageId} AND attempt_count = #{attemptCount} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
